title: Fix WorkerPool blocked_quota_types permanent stall on resume and empty quota_wait
todo_items: Refs: ISSUE-035. (1) WorkerPool.resume() must call self.blocked_quota_types.clear(). (2) WorkerPool._quota_probe_loop() must also clear self.blocked_quota_types (or prune types with no active QUOTA_WAIT jobs in DB) when awakened == 0 so deleting a course or retrying jobs never leaves blocked_quota_types stuck in memory. (3) QueueRepository.refresh_quota_wait(artifact_type=None, force=False) should support force=True for manual resume_quota_wait(), and BatchStudioService.resume_quota_wait() / retry_job() should clear the corresponding types from worker_pool.blocked_quota_types. (4) Add unit tests in tests/test_worker_pool.py.
